purpose: Test whether task-blind automatic Wiki formation generalizes to unseen domains and sources without weakening a strong raw-source or Claim-retrieval baseline.

candidateFreeze.note: The worktree contains intentional uncommitted project history; candidate identity is therefore the following content-hash tuple, not the Git commit alone.

threeEnvelopeProtocol.A1_CORPUS: New source snapshots and metadata only. Formation Worker can read this envelope and frozen code/config, but cannot read A2 or B.
threeEnvelopeProtocol.A2_QUESTIONS: Public neutral Chinese task text only. It is mounted only after A1 modules and hashes are frozen; Answer Worker may read A1, A2 and frozen candidate outputs, but not B.
threeEnvelopeProtocol.B_GOLD: Required facts, conditions, evidence quotations, forbidden claims, answerability and scoring rubric. Evaluator receives it only after all B/R0/W-auto first answers and their directory hash are frozen.

minimumDataset.historicalOverlap: No URL, content hash, repository/version, DOI/version or event cluster overlap with revealed A/B/C/S200/Evolution assets.

treatments.R0: Bounded canonical Claim retrieval with Wiki and online Graph disabled.
treatments.W_AUTO: The same R0 seeds and budget with seed-anchored automatic Wiki modules; Graph contribution, if any, must be reported separately and cannot be bundled into the Wiki effect.

fairness: Same answer model, temperature, visible context budget, task instruction and retry policy across treatments.
First answers are immutable; format repair is separately logged and bounded.
Provider input/output/cache tokens, latency, selected Claims, Wiki activation, injection rejection and final budget drops are retained per question.
Formation may not branch on domain labels, question text, case IDs, Gold strings or hand-selected Claim bundles.
primaryGates: Every visible Wiki assertion resolves to one canonical active Claim and all supporting EvidenceSpan records.
W_AUTO hard failures do not exceed R0 or B.
W_AUTO required-fact and required-condition coverage is not lower than R0 beyond the preregistered per-question tolerance of one non-critical item, and aggregate coverage is not lower.
W_AUTO either improves aggregate required coverage over R0 or reduces measured provider context tokens by at least 15% without an aggregate quality loss.
Against B, W_AUTO remains within 0.5 points on a 10-point blinded answer score and introduces no unsupported high-risk claim.
At least 20% of questions, including every hard failure and every claimed win, receive human evidence-faithfulness review.
stopRules: A failure after A2 is revealed permanently converts this dataset to Dev; repairs use a post-hoc run and never replace first answers.
Do not lower a gate, add a domain keyword or edit module membership after seeing A2 or B.
If W_AUTO loses because formation misses necessary cross-section composition, record wiki-formation as the failure layer; do not blame Graph or answer generation without trace evidence.
If W_AUTO has no benefit, keep Wiki as offline governance unless a new independent held-out cycle later establishes online marginal value.
